record.title: Lepton
record.name: Lepton
record.content:
Lepton is a 1/2 spin fermion that does not interact via the strong force. Today there are three flavours of leptons known. They are electron, muon, tau with their corresponding anti-particles. Neutrinos are also leptons and are divided in the three flavours.
All leptons (except neutrinos) have EM charge and their masses are well established. Also number of leptons in interactions is conserved even though the mass of the system might change. Flavour on the other hand is not conserved like in case of neutrino oscillations or muon decay.
